answer: A farm of 103 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in walnut, queued in meadow, and fable publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 65 identities per epoch. A farm of 2803 identities would post 3981 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
